title: Kevin Anton-Yan Marcos, Justin Pauldo-Rene Tellez Giron top next ProBoxTV event, October 16 in Phoenix
snippet: Kevin Anton, 14-0 (12 KOs), will defend his WBC Continental Americas junior-middleweight title against Cuba’s also undefeated Yan Marcos, 15-0 (10 KOs), in the main event of ProBoxTV’s Friday, October 16, live broadcast from the Rawhide Western Town & Event Center in Phoenix, Arizona. In the co-main event, WBC No. 5-ranked Justin Pauldo, 20-2, (10 KOs), of Houston will face WBO No. 11-ranked Rene Tellez Giron, 23-5 (14 KOs), of Queretaro, Mexico, in a 10-round lightweight battle.
